law.catch_line: When Commonwealth pays witnesses in case of misdemeanor
law.text:
Payment shall not be made out of the state treasury to a witness attending for the Commonwealth in any prosecution for a misdemeanor unless it appears that the sum to which the witness is entitled cannot be obtained:
If it be a case wherein there is a prosecutor and the defendant is convicted, by reason of the insolvency of the defendant, or
If it be a case in which there is no prosecutor, by reason of the acquittal or insolvency of the defendant or other cause.
